title: Post-v1: recording, effects, and advanced I/O
description: Deferred work that should not shape the v1 architecture. Keep the audio and domain boundaries ready for these features without shipping them early.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] v1 does not depend on these tasks.
- [ ] Each task lists the architectural hooks already in place.
- [ ] The post-v1 scope is reviewed after v1 ships.

title: Audio input capture and record-to-pad
description: Enumerate input devices, capture audio with latency compensation, and build a record, trim, normalize, and assign workflow.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Recording at 48 kHz works with one interface.
- [ ] Recorded samples are latency compensated.
- [ ] The workflow assigns to a pad in under 30 seconds.

title: ASIO backend
description: Evaluate an ASIO backend for lower latency and multi-channel interfaces, including licensing, build complexity, and fallback behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] One ASIO interface works end to end.
- [ ] Licensing is documented.
- [ ] Shared-mode fallback still works.

title: Multi-output routing
description: Allow pads or groups to route to separate outputs on multi-channel interfaces, with a compact routing UI.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] At least four outputs work independently.
- [ ] Routing persists in kits.
- [ ] Offline tests verify channel assignment.

title: Master EQ and reverb
description: Add a three-band master EQ and a global reverb send with presets, bypass, and CPU guardrails.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] EQ and reverb are audible and bypassable.
- [ ] CPU stays under 5% on reference hardware.
- [ ] Settings persist.

title: MIDI out, clock, and external sync
description: Send MIDI clock, start, and stop, map pads to MIDI out notes, and evaluate Ableton Link or external sync.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A DAW follows the app's clock.
- [ ] MIDI out notes map per pad.
- [ ] Jitter is measured and documented.

title: Foundation and engineering harness
description: Stand up a Windows-first Rust workspace, CI, observability, configuration, and build/release plumbing. This epic removes shared uncertainty so audio, input, and UI work can proceed in parallel.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Workspace builds, tests, and lints on a clean Windows machine.
- [ ] A release build can be produced from a tagged commit.
- [ ] Architecture decisions and developer setup are documented.

title: Bootstrap Cargo workspace and crate boundaries
description: Create a workspace with drumpad-model, drumpad-samples, drumpad-engine, drumpad-audio, drumpad-input, drumpad-app, and drumpad-tools. Enforce dependency direction so model and samples stay free of Windows and UI dependencies.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] cargo build, test, fmt, and clippy pass on Windows.
- [x] Model and samples have no dependency on egui, winit, cpal, or midir.
- [x] Crate responsibilities are documented in the README.
close_reason: Orchestrator verified the scaffold: cargo build, test, fmt, and clippy pass; crate boundaries split into model/samples/engine/audio/input/app/tools.

title: Windows CI pipeline
description: Add GitHub Actions on windows-latest for formatting, clippy with warnings denied, unit tests, and a release build. Cache Rust artifacts and upload the portable build.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] CI runs on every PR and on main.
- [x] Clippy warnings fail the build.
- [x] Release artifact is downloadable from CI.
notes: Verified 2026-11-07: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers push/main + pull_request + workflow_dispatch; clippy step uses -D warnings; release build + packaging + upload-artifact@v7 of dist/*.zip. YAML parses; local equivalents pass; GitHub execution not observable in-session (no push).
close_reason: E01-T02 complete: GitHub Actions CI on windows-latest with fmt, clippy -D warnings, workspace tests, locked release build, portable ZIP packaging, and upload-artifact v7 download. YAML validated; local equivalents pass. Caveat: no push in this session, so the first real GitHub run is unobserved; workspace-wide gates currently depend on other pairs' in-flight code.

title: Logging, error model, and crash capture
description: Use tracing for structured logs, thiserror for typed errors, and a panic hook that writes a crash report with version, device info, and backtrace. Keep logs local and rotate them.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Logs land in the app log directory and rotate.
- [x] Panics write a crash report without requiring a console.
- [x] No user sample paths or personal data are sent anywhere.
notes: Verified 2026-11-07: daily rolling log in AppPaths::log_dir with max_log_files=retention+1 (init sentinel test reads the line back); panic-hook integration test in tests/crash_hook.rs writes a local report without a console; no network/telemetry deps in cargo tree, home paths redacted, ADR-0006 documents local-only diagnostics.
close_reason: E01-T03 complete: thiserror typed error model, tracing daily rolling logs with retention and RUST_LOG override, panic hook with version/OS/thread/device-context/backtrace writing a local report with no console, home-path redaction, local-only diagnostics (ADR-0006), and tests including a real-panic integration test.

title: App paths, settings, and portable mode
description: Resolve config, data, cache, and log directories with directories-rs. Add a typed settings file with schema version, atomic writes, and a portable marker file that keeps all data beside the executable.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] First launch creates the expected directory tree.
- [x] Settings round-trip and reject invalid values.
- [x] Portable mode stores data next to the executable.
notes: Verified 2026-11-07: ensure() creates config/data/cache/logs/crashes (test + portable smoke); AppSettings JSON round-trip, unknown fields/versions and invalid values rejected; portable marker puts DrumpadData beside the exe (test + ZIP smoke run). Installed logs/crashes are siblings of data per dev guide.
close_reason: E01-T04 complete: directories-rs installed layout, portable marker + DrumpadData beside exe, first-launch directory creation, versioned validated settings JSON with atomic writes, installed logs/crashes as siblings of data; tests and portable/ZIP smoke runs pass.

title: Release profile, icon, and portable ZIP
description: Configure an optimized Windows 11 x64 release profile with LTO and stripped symbols, embed icon and version resources, hide the console, and add a script that builds a portable ZIP with licenses.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] cargo build --release produces a GUI executable for Windows 11 x64.
- [x] The ZIP contains the executable, README, and third-party notices.
- [x] Version metadata appears in Windows file properties.
notes: Verified 2026-11-07: cargo build --workspace --release --locked produced PE32+ subsystem 2 (GUI); VersionInfo FileVersion/ProductVersion 0.1.0, ProductName Drumpad, FileDescription, CompanyName, LegalCopyright, OriginalFilename; ZIP contains Drumpad.exe, README.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, drumpad.portable + .sha256; extracted ZIP ran and created DrumpadData beside the exe.
close_reason: E01-T05 complete: release profile (O3, fat LTO, codegen-units 1, strip debuginfo), winresource icon and version metadata (Win32 PE32+ subsystem 2 GUI), portable ZIP with exe/README/third-party notices/portable marker and SHA256; verified release build, VersionInfo, ZIP contents, and extracted-ZIP portable run.

title: Benchmark and offline render harness
description: Add Criterion benchmarks for voice mixing, resampling, and kit loading, plus a headless offline renderer that feeds deterministic blocks and trigger sequences.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] cargo bench reports stable baseline numbers.
- [ ] Offline renderer produces deterministic output for fixtures.
- [ ] The harness runs without an audio device.

title: ADRs and developer setup guide
description: Record decisions for the audio backend, UI stack, keyboard latency path, kit format, and sample storage. Write a Windows setup guide covering Rust, build tools, MIDI loopback, and audio testing.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Each major stack choice has an ADR with alternatives and tradeoffs.
- [x] A new contributor can build, run, and test from the guide.
- [x] The guide is linked from the README.
notes: Verified 2026-11-07: ADRs 0001-0007 cover audio backend, UI stack, keyboard latency path, kit format, sample storage, local-only diagnostics, release profile, each with alternatives/consequences; docs/dev/windows-setup.md covers toolchain, build/run/test, CI, data paths, portable mode, MIDI loopback, Nitro Max, audio testing, troubleshooting; README links ADRs + guide.
close_reason: E01-T07 complete: ADRs 0001-0007 for audio backend, UI stack, keyboard latency path, kit format, sample storage, local-only diagnostics, release profile; Windows developer setup guide; README links to ADRs, guide, interfaces, and third-party notices.

title: Hardening, QA, and release
description: Prove the app is fast, stable, and shippable on real Windows hardware. Add automated coverage, latency validation, compatibility testing, soak tests, onboarding, and release gates.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Core and audio tests run in CI on Windows.
- [ ] The app survives an 8-hour soak with no leak or crash.
- [ ] A release candidate passes the documented latency and compatibility gates.

title: Latency budget and measurement protocol
description: Define the MIDI-to-audio and key-to-audio latency targets, the reference hardware (Finding 35-key keyboard, Nitro Max, onboard 3.5 mm output), and a repeatable loopback measurement protocol that includes the Nitro Max USB-MIDI and Aux In path. Record baseline results in the repo.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Targets and tolerances are written down.
- [ ] The protocol includes the Finding 35-key keyboard and the Nitro Max Aux In chain.
- [ ] Baseline results are stored with hardware details.

title: Beta program and release checklist
description: Recruit testers, provide an issue template, collect latency and compatibility reports, and define release candidate sign-off and rollback steps.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] At least five external testers run the beta.
- [ ] Release notes list known issues.
- [ ] A release candidate is signed off or blocked with reasons.

title: Core unit test suite
description: Cover kit invariants, mappings, velocity curves, voice allocation, queue behavior, and sample metadata with fast deterministic tests.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Core coverage is at least 80%.
- [ ] Tests run in under 30 seconds.
- [ ] No test requires audio hardware.

title: Offline audio golden tests
description: Render fixture kits and trigger sequences to memory and compare RMS, peak, and sample data within tolerance. Catch gain, pitch, choke, and limiter regressions.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Golden tests cover one-shot, gate, loop, choke, and limiter paths.
- [ ] Failures identify the affected fixture.
- [ ] Tests are stable on CI.

title: Fake MIDI and audio integration harness
description: Drive the app with scripted MIDI and keyboard sequences through a fake backend, then assert triggers, voice counts, and output levels end to end.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A full trigger sequence runs without hardware.
- [ ] The harness is part of CI.
- [ ] Failures include the sequence and voice state.

title: UI smoke tests
description: Use egui_kittest or screenshot tests to cover the pad grid, inspector, settings, kit browser, and keyboard navigation. Review snapshots for regressions.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Critical flows have automated coverage.
- [ ] Snapshots are reviewed on change.
- [ ] Tests run in CI without a GPU requirement.

title: Compatibility matrix and soak testing
description: Test Windows 11 x64 (current and previous release), onboard and USB audio, 44.1/48/96 kHz, the Finding 35-key single-hand keyboard, and the Alesis Nitro Max with Local Mode OFF through the onboard 3.5 mm to Aux In path. Run an 8-hour soak with voices, MIDI hotplug, and UI animation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The Windows 11 x64 matrix is filled in and linked from the release notes.
- [ ] The Nitro Max USB-MIDI and onboard 3.5 mm Aux In path is verified.
- [ ] The Finding 35-key keyboard maps and rolls over correctly.
- [ ] Soak testing shows no leak, crash, or xrun growth.
- [ ] Known limitations are documented.

title: Startup, load, and responsiveness budgets
description: Measure cold start, kit load, and UI frame time, then gate regressions. Move blocking work off the UI thread where needed.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Cold start is under 2 seconds.
- [ ] A typical kit loads in under 1 second.
- [ ] UI stays at 60 fps during playback.

title: User manual, setup guide, and troubleshooting
description: Write the user manual covering kits, samples, keyboard and keypad mapping, latency tuning, performance mode, and the Nitro Max Local Mode and Aux In setup. Include an in-app help entry point.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A new user can set up and play from the docs.
- [ ] The Nitro Max guide covers USB-MIDI, Local Mode, Aux In, and hi-hat calibration.
- [ ] Troubleshooting covers device loss and missing samples.

title: Installer, signing, and licenses
description: Produce a Windows 11 x64 installer alongside the portable ZIP, with uninstall support, optional code signing, and third-party license notices. Document SmartScreen expectations.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Installer installs and uninstalls cleanly on Windows 11 x64.
- [ ] The portable ZIP remains available.
- [ ] All dependencies and samples are attributed.

title: App shell and pad UI
description: Build the lightweight native interface: a stage-ready 4x4 pad grid, a focused inspector, kit browsing, settings, a keyboard map overlay, and clear error handling. The UI must never block the audio path.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The app is usable at 1280x720 and 1080p.
- [ ] Pad hits animate within one frame.
- [ ] The active keyboard or keypad map is visible in the app.
- [ ] Every recoverable error has a visible next action.

title: Custom winit and egui app shell
description: Create the window, event loop, egui integration, DPI handling, theme setup, and graceful shutdown. Wire the low-latency keyboard hook from the input epic.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The app launches, renders at 60 fps idle, and exits cleanly.
- [ ] DPI changes do not break layout.
- [ ] Keyboard events are forwarded immediately.

title: First-run setup wizard
description: Guide a new user through audio device selection, MIDI device selection, keyboard profile choice (full keyboard or Finding 35-key single-hand keyboard), and sample folder choice. Allow skipping and revisiting from Settings.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A clean install reaches a playable state with the chosen keyboard profile.
- [ ] Skipped steps can be completed later.
- [ ] The wizard never blocks the app on missing hardware.

title: Keyboard map overlay and key hints
description: Add an overlay that shows the active keyboard or keypad mapping, highlights the pad on key press, and can be opened from Performance mode. For the Finding 35-key keyboard, show the 4x4 pad block, the unmapped fifth column, and the F1-F5 transport row. F5 opens and closes the overlay.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The overlay matches the active profile.
- [ ] The overlay shows the Finding 35-key layout, including the unmapped fifth column and F1-F5 actions.
- [ ] F5 opens and closes the overlay.
- [ ] Key presses highlight the corresponding pad.
- [ ] The overlay is readable at 1080p and does not block playing.

title: Navigation and layout
description: Add Performance, Edit, and Settings views with a top bar, status bar, and keyboard shortcuts. Preserve audio and editor state when switching views.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Views switch without interrupting playback.
- [ ] State survives navigation.
- [ ] Shortcuts are documented in the UI.

title: Pad grid
description: Render a 4x4 pad grid with sample names, key and MIDI hints, hit flash, velocity ring, level meters, selection, and DPI-aware sizing. Key labels update with the active full-keyboard or one-hand profile.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All 16 pads fit at 1280x720.
- [ ] Hit feedback appears within one frame.
- [ ] Key labels match the active profile.
- [ ] The grid remains legible on a stage display.

title: Pad inspector
description: Edit the selected pad's sample slot, layers, playback mode, volume, pan, tune, choke group, MIDI note, and keyboard key. Changes apply live with validation and reset.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Every pad setting is editable and persists.
- [ ] Invalid values are blocked with a reason.
- [ ] Preview triggers use the current settings.

title: Kit browser and CRUD UI
description: List and search kits, create, duplicate, rename, delete, and load them with progress. Handle unsaved changes and load failures.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Kit operations work from the UI.
- [ ] Loading a kit does not freeze the window.
- [ ] Unsaved changes prompt before switching.

title: Settings UI
description: Expose audio device, sample rate, buffer, MIDI device, keyboard mapping, appearance, and advanced diagnostics. Validate changes and explain restart requirements.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Settings apply or clearly require a restart.
- [ ] Invalid combinations are blocked.
- [ ] Settings persist across launches.

title: Performance mode
description: Add a full-screen performance view with large pads, hidden editing chrome, key labels, and the F1-F5 transport row: panic, metronome, previous kit, next kit, and keyboard map overlay.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Performance mode is usable at 1080p from a distance.
- [ ] F1-F5 trigger panic, metronome, previous kit, next kit, and the map overlay.
- [ ] No accidental edits are possible.
- [ ] Exiting restores the previous view.

title: Visual design, dialogs, and error UX
description: Define a dark, high-contrast stage theme with tokens for color, type, spacing, and focus. Add toasts, modals, unsaved-change prompts, device-loss dialogs, and missing-sample recovery.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Colors and typography come from tokens.
- [ ] Contrast is readable on stage and in a dark room.
- [ ] Every error dialog offers a concrete action.

title: Drag-and-drop sample assignment
description: Drop an audio file or folder onto a pad to assign it, with a preview and confirmation. Support undo and clear feedback for unsupported files.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Drop assignment works from Explorer.
- [ ] Accidental drops can be undone.
- [ ] Unsupported files do not change the pad.

title: Audio backend and device management
description: Own the Windows audio device lifecycle and deliver a stable, low-latency stream. The backend must handle shared and exclusive modes, device loss, and realistic buffer sizes without blocking the real-time path.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] 48 kHz at 128 frames runs for 30 minutes without xruns on reference hardware.
- [ ] Unplugging and reconnecting a device recovers without restarting the app.
- [ ] Measured latency is reported to the user and documented.

title: Audio backend spike and latency measurement
description: Prototype cpal WASAPI shared mode and the wasapi crate's exclusive mode on Windows 11 x64. Measure callback interval, round-trip latency, CPU, and xrun behavior at 48 kHz with 64, 128, and 256 frames.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] A measurement table compares shared and exclusive modes.
- [x] The recommendation states whether shared mode meets the latency target.
- [x] Exclusive mode is only added if the measurements justify it.
- [x] The prototype and raw results are archived.
close_reason: Spike implemented in crates/drumpad-audio/src/bin/latency_spike.rs; measurement table + recommendation in docs/audio/backend-spike.md; raw JSON archived. Cleaner reviewed and confirmed all four acceptance items.

title: Audio backend abstraction and device enumeration
description: Define an AudioBackend trait that lists devices, reports supported configurations, opens a stream, and closes it cleanly. Provide a fake backend for tests and keep the Windows implementation behind a platform module.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Device and configuration enumeration works on Windows.
- [x] A fake backend supports deterministic tests.
- [x] No audio backend types leak into drumpad-core.
close_reason: AudioBackend trait + WindowsDeviceProvider/FakeBackend + SupportedConfig negotiation in crates/drumpad-audio; no WASAPI types leak outside the platform module. Tests: 33 audio lib tests, hardware device listing.

title: Stream lifecycle and format negotiation
description: Implement start, stop, restart, sample-rate selection, buffer-size selection, and shared/exclusive mode selection. Resolve unsupported combinations with a clear fallback rather than failing silently.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Start and stop 100 times without leaking handles or threads.
- [x] Unsupported formats fall back predictably.
- [x] Errors identify the device and requested format.
close_reason: Stream lifecycle/format negotiation in stream.rs: shared low-latency then shared default, exclusive S16/S24 with BUFFER_SIZE_NOT_ALIGNED recovery, explicit fallback and device+format errors. 100 real-device open/stop cycles pass; unsupported-format fallback unit test.

title: Real-time callback skeleton and xrun tracking
description: Create the audio callback with preallocated buffers, silence on empty input, callback timing, and xrun counting. No allocation, locking, logging, or file access inside the callback.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Callback cadence matches the configured buffer size.
- [x] Xruns are counted and exposed to the UI.
- [x] The RT-safety test detects forbidden operations in debug builds.
close_reason: RT callback skeleton + StreamDiagnostics (callbacks, xruns, late, timeouts, load, last interval) and device format reporting; audio thread uses MMCSS Pro Audio. Hardware shared/exclusive runs show 0 xruns; rt_safety source scan and allocation guardrail pass.

title: Audio settings persistence and safe fallback
description: Persist the selected device, sample rate, buffer size, and mode. Validate the saved configuration at startup and fall back to the default device when it is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Settings survive restart.
- [x] An invalid or missing device falls back without a crash.
- [x] The user sees which device and format are active.
close_reason: AudioSettings JSON schema with validation, atomic save, load-defaults on missing/corrupt, and resolve_device id->name->default fallback. Unit tests cover round-trip, invalid values, corrupt file, and fallback order.

title: Device loss and hotplug recovery
description: Detect unplug, format changes, and device disappearance. Stop the stream safely, notify the user, and attempt reconnection without losing kit state.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Unplug and replug recovers within two seconds.
- [x] No stuck voices or crashes occur.
- [x] The UI clearly shows the disconnected state.
close_reason: AudioSystem reconnect state machine: detects DeviceLost/Error/stopped stream, polls devices, reopens with a fresh callback, emits DeviceLost/Disconnected/Reconnected events; FakeBackend test recovers well under 2 s and drops the old stream cleanly.

title: Latency diagnostics and exclusive-mode follow-up
description: Expose buffer size, estimated and measured latency, callback load, and xruns in a diagnostics view. Add WASAPI exclusive mode only if shared mode misses the target, and document ASIO as a post-v1 option.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Diagnostics match the configured stream and remain readable during playback.
- [x] Exclusive mode is selectable only when implemented.
- [x] The latency guide explains the tradeoffs.
close_reason: Diagnostics expose negotiated buffer/period/sample format/stream latency/load/xruns/voice count; exclusive mode selectable via ShareMode; latency model unified to max(buffer, period, driver latency); docs/audio/latency-guide.md documents tradeoffs and ASIO as post-v1.

title: MIDI and Alesis Nitro Max integration
description: Connect an Alesis Nitro Max over USB-MIDI and integrate its Aux In monitoring path. Cover note mapping, Local Mode, velocity curves, hi-hat articulations, hotplug, MIDI learn, and diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Nitro Max pads trigger pads over USB-MIDI.
- [ ] With Local Mode OFF, the app is the sound source and returns audio through the Nitro Max Aux In.
- [ ] Hi-hat open, half-open, closed, pedal, and splash trigger the expected layers.
- [ ] Unplugging the kit never leaves stuck voices.

title: MIDI backend and enumeration
description: Wrap midir input in a platform-neutral interface with device enumeration, open and close, and a fake backend for tests. Surface connection errors to the UI.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] All MIDI input ports are listed.
- [x] Opening a selected port works and errors are typed.
- [x] Tests use the fake backend without hardware.
notes: MIDI backend in crates/drumpad-input/src/midi/backend.rs: MidiInputBackend trait, MidirBackend (feature midir-backend, default on) with real enumeration/open and typed errors, FakeMidiBackend for hardware-free tests. Port listing, open, missing-port, forced-failure, and idempotent-close tests all use the fake backend.
close_reason: Cleaner review complete: all acceptance criteria checked, tests cover the behavior, cargo test -p drumpad-input (155 unit + 4 integration + 1 doctest), clippy -D warnings, fmt --check pass. Committed path-scoped.

title: Nitro Max Aux In signal chain, Local Mode, and gain staging
description: Implement and document the Nitro Max monitoring chain: pads to USB-MIDI to the app to the PC onboard 3.5 mm output to Nitro Max Aux In to phones and audio outputs. Add Local Mode guidance, a gain-staging check, and a latency and flam test. If Local Mode stays on, document the tradeoff.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] With Local Mode OFF, app samples are the only drum source and play through the module's Aux In.
- [ ] The onboard 3.5 mm output feeds the Aux In without clipping.
- [ ] Gain staging avoids clipping at the module input.
- [x] The guide explains Local Mode ON versus OFF and any flam risk.
- [ ] Measured latency for the full chain is recorded.
notes: Nitro Max monitoring chain documented in crates/drumpad-input/docs/nitro-max.md: full signal diagram, Local Mode ON/OFF tradeoff and flam risk, Aux In gain-staging checklist, per-chain latency table, and troubleshooting order. Physical clipping, analogue chain, and full-chain latency criteria are hardware/audio-pair gated and stay unchecked.
close_reason: Nitro Max signal chain, Local Mode ON/OFF tradeoff, gain-staging checklist, latency table and troubleshooting documented in docs/nitro-max.md. Physical clipping/analogue latency criteria left unchecked as hardware/audio-pair follow-up.

title: Hotplug, reconnect, and device persistence
description: Rescan MIDI ports periodically, reconnect the saved device after unplug, and avoid opening the same port twice. Notify the UI when the device disappears or returns.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Unplug and replug reconnects automatically.
- [x] The selected device survives restart.
- [x] No duplicate callbacks or leaks occur.
notes: Hotplug in crates/drumpad-input/src/midi/hotplug.rs: polls ports, closes vanished connections, reconnects the saved device by name, no duplicate opens, typed reconnect failures, preferences JSON survives restart. Tests cover unplug/replug, repeated polls, failed reopen recovery, and selection persistence.
close_reason: Cleaner review complete: all acceptance criteria checked, tests cover the behavior, cargo test -p drumpad-input (155 unit + 4 integration + 1 doctest), clippy -D warnings, fmt --check pass. Committed path-scoped.

title: MIDI parsing and note mapping
description: Parse note on, note off, velocity zero, CC, and channel messages. Filter by channel, ignore clock and active sensing, and map notes to pads through the kit model.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Note on triggers the mapped pad.
- [x] Note off releases gate-mode pads.

Note on triggers the mapped pad and note off releases gate pads; Nitro Max template covers all documented zones. Channel filtering and ignored messages are tested.
close_reason: Cleaner review complete: all acceptance criteria checked, tests cover the behavior, cargo test -p drumpad-input (155 unit + 4 integration + 1 doctest), clippy -D warnings, fmt --check pass. Committed path-scoped.

title: MIDI learn and mapping editor
description: Let the user arm a pad, hit a note or pedal, and capture the mapping. Detect conflicts, offer a test trigger, and persist global and per-kit mappings.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Learn captures notes and CC messages.
- [x] Conflicts are shown before saving.
- [x] Mappings persist and survive reload.

title: Velocity curve engine
description: Map MIDI velocity 1-127 through linear, soft, hard, and fixed curves, with per-pad sensitivity and a custom multi-point curve. Use a precomputed lookup table.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Curves are monotonic where expected.
- [x] Boundary velocities map correctly.
- [ ] The UI previews the curve.
notes: Velocity curves in crates/drumpad-input/src/midi/velocity.rs: linear, soft, hard, fixed, custom multi-point, compiled to a 128-entry LUT; per-pad sensitivity after the curve. Monotonicity, boundary 1/127 values, custom interpolation, clamping, and config JSON round-trip tested. VelocityCurveTable::table() provides preview data for the UI; rendering belongs to the app pair.
close_reason: Linear/soft/hard/fixed/custom velocity curves compiled to a 128-entry LUT with per-pad sensitivity; monotonic and boundary tests pass; preview table exposed for the app UI (UI criterion left unchecked, app-pair handoff).

title: Hi-hat engine for Nitro Max notes and CC pedals
description: Handle the Nitro Max discrete hi-hat notes (46 open, 23 half-open, 42 closed, 44 pedal, 21 splash) and continuous CC4 or CC64 position for modules that send it. Add hysteresis, pedal chick, splash, choke, and calibration.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Nitro Max notes select the expected articulation.

title: Voice pool and stealing policy

title: One-shot playback and interpolation

title: Live performance features

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Velocity layers and round-robin work with keyboard and MIDI.
- [ ] The metronome stays in sync for an hour.
- [ ] Kit switching during a set does not crash or leave stuck voices.

title: Velocity layer model and selection

acceptance_criteria:

- [ ] Boundary velocities select the correct layer.
- [ ] The UI can preview each layer.

title: Round-robin groups

acceptance_criteria:

acceptance_criteria:

- [ ] Choke groups can be edited and tested.
- [ ] Settings persist.

title: Loop sync and quantized start
